coverageContract.eligibleDefinition: Actual native solver instances admitted with at least8 futurepoints; constructors may legitimately never receive a query
coverageContract.executedDefinition: Actual future-point distance lookups in the owned solver contexts, including real batch work beyond the accepted serial prefix
coverageContract.changedDefinition: Actual mixed-hash lookup path executed. Hit counts are not additional avoided baseline scans: baseline already has a256-entry cache. Only fresh paired runtime and exact published outputs assess improvement.

transport: Exact producer-framed retained inner ZIP/member bytes; not original Actions API server-ZIP identity. Authenticated producer/run/head/attempt/case and independent source/input/oracle raw qualification required.
queryEvidence: Counterfactual native-cache work on the observed candidate-owned query prefix. No actual baseline run and no independent correctness oracle on native misses.
admissionScope: Only internally admitted owned primitive-XYZ/native-key contexts with initial future count at least8. Not all nearest-function calls or all initial-HD work; no scaling by the whole-function profiler pool.
